hero.tagline: Local semantic search for AI agents
hero.title: Your context window runs out before your problem does.
hero.subtitle: Grimoire indexes your codebase on your machine and hands your AI agent only the snippets that matter — file and line included. No cloud, no Docker, no API key.
hero.install: claude mcp add grimoire -- uvx grimoire-mcp

before.label: Without Grimoire
before.desc: Agent re-reads 15 full files to answer one question

after.label: With Grimoire
after.desc: Agent retrieves the 5 snippets that actually matter

items.title: Structural chunking
items.desc: tree-sitter splits code into real units — functions, classes, methods — never blind text blocks.

items.title: Hybrid search
items.desc: Vector search for concepts ("where is CPF validated?") plus BM25 for exact identifiers (getUserById). Fused with RRF.

items.title: Zero infrastructure
items.desc: Embeddings run locally. The index is a file on disk. Your code never leaves your machine.

items.title: Always fresh
items.desc: Each search re-indexes only the files that changed. No daemon, no stale results.

steps.label: Add to Claude Code
steps.code: claude mcp add grimoire -- uvx grimoire-mcp

steps.label: Ask your agent
steps.code: "search the project for where discounts are calculated"
